NovaPay operates globally, but with certain restrictions and limitations. We cannot open accounts for residents of the following countries:

- United States (regulatory restrictions under US law)
- Iran

- Cuba
- Syria
- Sudan and South Sudan
- Russia (suspended since March 2022)
- Belarus (suspended since March 2022)

We also have restrictions on certain transaction corridors, and may decline transactions to or from restricted countries.

NovaPay is subject to various regulatory frameworks, including:

- Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations
- Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations
- Sanctions regulations, including OFAC, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UN Security Council Sanctions, and HM Treasury Financial Sanctions list
- Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) for e-money institutions
- General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for data protection and privacy

We also follow the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) recommendations on anti-money laundering and combating the financing of terrorism.
